Fractional Regression Models

fracreg-package.Rd

Provides tools for the estimation and specification analysis of both one-part and two-part fractional regression models. It supports various link functions, allows for the calculation of average and conditional partial effects, and provides several specification tests such as RESET, P test, and GGOFF tests.
